blocks.content: Selection sort works by repeatedly selecting the smallest (or largest) unsorted element and placing it towards the beginning of the list.
Suppose we need to sort a list in ascending order using selection sort.

items: Select the smallest element from the list.
Swap this element with the first element.

blocks.content: At this point, the correct element is placed at the first position. However, the portion of the list from the second position to the last remains unsorted. Therefore,

items: Select the smallest element from the remaining unsorted part (from the second to last positions) of the list.
Swap this element with the second element.
Continue this process for each following position until the entire list is sorted.
